subject: MAP Kickstart: Solis Health pilot goals & 90-day timeline
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solishealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickstart: Solis Health pilot goals & 90-day timeline

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align on pilot goals, owners, and a proposed 90-day timeline so we can get the pilot up and running with clear success criteria. I’ve looped in Karthik (solutions) and Marcus (CS) so we can route technical and operations items quickly.

High-level proposed plan (TL;DR):
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference for clinical note summarization across 3 specialties (Primary Care, Cardio, Endocrinology) with parity on latency and >90% accuracy on our evaluation set.
- Pilot scope: 5k notes/day ingest, integration via REST API (staging) + sample batch export.
- Key milestones (90 days):
  - Week 1: Kickoff + environment access; agree on eval dataset and success metrics.
  - Weeks 2–4: Integration + test runs; initial quality checks.
  - Weeks 5–8: Performance tuning (batching/quantization), cost estimates.
  - Weeks 9–12: Final validation, rollout recommendations, SOW review for production.

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the pilot objective and the three specialties above (or suggest edits).
2) Who will be the internal stakeholders/approvers we should include on the MAP (CTO, security, procurement)?
3) Are there any contractual or compliance checkpoints (e.g., SOC 2 evidence) you want on the timeline?

I attached a one-page MAP starter template and a draft SOW for your review. If the outline looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week (I’m available Tue/Thu mornings).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP-starter-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Solis_SOW-draft-v0.1.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solishealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@solishealth.com>, procurement@solishealth.com
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickstart: Solis Health pilot goals & 90-day timeline

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the concise plan. Quick answers below: 

- Objectives: Agree on clinical note summarization; I’d like to add measuring hallucination rate per specialty as an explicit success metric (we'll use our adjudication set).
- Stakeholders: Tom Reynolds (CTO) will be our technical approver; Maria Santos (AI Lead) will own the evaluation side — I’ll introduce her in the kickoff invite. I’ve CC’d Tom and procurement.
- Compliance: We will need a short SOC 2 evidence pack (standard items: network diagrams, access control logs) during the integration phase; procurement will confirm exact docs.

Timing: We are aiming to start integration by June 21 to hit a pilot-ready state before Q3 planning. Tue/Thu mornings next week work for me for a kickoff — can we do Thursday 10:00 AM PT?

A couple of notes:
- Can your team confirm expected staging IP ranges and any firewall steps we should pre-provision?
- Please call out any dependencies on our side (API auth, sample notes export format).

If you can update the MAP template to include the hallucination metric and move Week 1 dates earlier (for June 21 start), that'd be great.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director of Digital Transformation | Solis Health
alicia.gomez@solishealth.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@solishealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@solishealth.com>, procurement@solishealth.com
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickstart: Solis Health pilot goals & 90-day timeline

Alicia — thanks for the quick responses and the target date. 

We’ll add hallucination rate (per specialty) as a success metric and update the template to reflect a Week 1 target of June 21 (integration kickoff). Karthik will send the staging IP ranges and firewall checklist by Monday, and Marcus will document the data export spec we prefer (CSV + JSON examples).

Proposed kickoff: Thu, Jun 17 at 10:00 AM PT — same week gives us a short runway to provision network access. If you prefer Jun 21 as the integration start, we can use Jun 17 for an internal/ops alignment + stakeholder introductions. Please confirm which you prefer and I’ll send a calendar invite with the updated MAP attached.

Next owners/actions (short):
- Jasmine: update MAP template, send invite for Jun 17/21
- Karthik: staging IPs & firewall checklist (due Mon, Jun 7)
- Marcus: export spec + sample payload (due Wed, Jun 9)
- Alicia/Tom: confirm kickoff date and add any procurement docs needed

Thanks — we’ll attach the revised MAP and a checklist in the invite.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
